operator_scope_deviations.record: An auxiliary package red-team reviewer accidentally created /tmp/SHOULD_NOT_WRITE_THIS on MARS, immediately unlinked it, and confirmed the path absent. This violated the MARS metadata/read-only operator contract even though no persistent state remained.

open_findings.hostile_proof: A disposable venv sitecustomize marker executed before a child body under -I -B (sys.flags.no_site=0); the same marker did not execute under -I -B -S (sys.flags.no_site=1).
open_findings.impact: Unreviewed venv .pth/sitecustomize code can run before the runtime probe imports NumPy or consumes reviewed snapshots, while all package and Python executable hashes still appear valid.
open_findings.required_fix: Use a startup path that disables site initialization and then imports NumPy only from a separately hash-bound, descriptor-consumed closure; add a real venv .pth/sitecustomize hostile test.
open_findings.title: Runtime probe executes unbound venv site initialization

open_findings.hostile_proof: The actual preflight validator accepted review booleans encoded as integer 1, findings integers encoded as false, and authority booleans encoded as 0/1. The actual training validator separately accepted findings encoded as false and all required checks encoded as integer 1.
open_findings.impact: Documents advertised as exact external authority receipts are accepted with incorrect JSON types, so the recorded schema is not byte-semantic and QA3-R004 is not fully closed.
open_findings.required_fix: Use recursive exact JSON type-and-value comparison for every external GO field in preflight, materialization, and training validators; add bool/int hostile cases.
open_findings.title: Exact GO validators accept JSON bool/int aliases

open_findings.hostile_proof: During a result-blind fixture the prepared receipt directory was renamed and replaced after setup. PASS was published into the replacement; after deleting that owner-controlled closure, the same GO, nonce, SHA, and lexical path produced another PASS on a third inode.
open_findings.impact: One reviewed GO can yield multiple accepted PASS receipts at one lexical path, defeating no-clobber, exact-once, and receipt-denominator integrity.
open_findings.required_fix: Hold and bind the receipt-root directory FD and dev/inode for the entire preflight, use an external one-use lease, write only through dir_fd, and consume the lease before PASS publication.
open_findings.title: Receipt root is replaceable and the same GO is replayable

open_findings.hostile_proof: A parent-directory fsync failure after PASS file write/fchmod and receipt-directory freeze raised from main while leaving an otherwise downstream-acceptable immutable PASS file and no separate committed terminal marker.
open_findings.impact: Process exit says failure but the remaining PASS can be consumed as success, creating a split-brain terminal state.
open_findings.required_fix: Publish a separately committed terminal marker only after file, directory, and parent durability succeeds, and require downstream gates to bind that marker; ambiguous publication must be an immutable failure closure.
open_findings.title: PASS publication is visible before the durability transaction commits

open_findings.hostile_proof: The exact child environment blocks inherited PYTHONPATH, but disposable-venv evidence shows CPython -I -B still executes venv sitecustomize/.pth before the frozen trainer; -S is absent from the trainer prefix.
open_findings.impact: Unbound startup code can change the frozen training program or numerical runtime even though argv, environment, Python executable SHA, and trainer SHA all match. QA3-RUN001 is therefore not closed.
open_findings.required_fix: Disable site initialization for the trainer and provide a separately hash-bound import closure for NumPy and the exact splitter, or bind every executable .pth/sitecustomize dependency and prove it with native hostile tests.
open_findings.title: Trainer isolation still permits unbound venv site initialization

open_findings.hostile_proof: An isolated local copy of the exact role-separated package layout and an auxiliary read-only check of the immutable MARS package both failed runner --help with ModuleNotFoundError for rfic_transformer_inverse_design.controlled_real10k_20k_contract. The trainer instead resolved model_splitting from an external package path outside package_v3; its current bytes happened to match but that path and future bytes are not held or import-bound. Native smoke compiles runner/trainer but does not import their controlled dependency graph.
open_findings.impact: The package is either not executable as its own reviewed closure or can silently consume an externally installed, unbound rfic_transformer_inverse_design/model_splitting package.
open_findings.required_fix: Package an exact importable module tree (or descriptor-execute the verified module graph), bind the trainer's actually imported splitter bytes, and make native smoke import the real runner/trainer consumer graph under the production startup contract.
open_findings.title: Role-separated package does not close runner/trainer imports

open_findings.impact: The public QA-required record says only preflight_receipt_dir is a required binding, while the actual validator requires package, runtime, host/boot, candidate paths, and native role bindings.
open_findings.required_fix: Declare the complete exact GO binding keyset and the current six-hour reviewer lifetime policy in the frozen QA-required artifact.
open_findings.title: QA-required interface underdeclares exact GO bindings

open_findings.impact: Renamed/module-launched equivalents can be missed, argument text can false-match, and a process can appear after the post-scan.
open_findings.required_fix: Use exact /proc argv/executable/script identities plus a contract-bound singleton lock/lease that remains held through terminal publication.
open_findings.title: Singleton discovery remains substring-based and TOCTOU-prone

prior_qa_v3_p1_closure.evidence: Builder/shared/splitter and source/protocol inputs are consumed from one held byte closure; targeted hostile tests passed.
Parent PYTHONPATH inheritance is closed, but QA4-RUN001 proves venv sitecustomize/.pth still executes under -I -B.
Prepared root dev/inode and external one-use lease are held and hostile replacement/second-claim tests pass.
Evaluator GO SHA and parse consume one held O_NOFOLLOW byte snapshot.
Evaluator recursively rejects JSON bool/int aliases before claim.
Post-claim failure creates an immutable indexed consumed-lease closure and cannot replay.
